run_bench_pq_tables: run a benchmark of FAISS ProductQuantizer distance and inner product table computation across dimensions
run_bench_single_config: run a single ProductQuantizer benchmark with a specific dimension, sub-dimension, nbit, and metric
format_tab_results: format a 2D numpy array of benchmark results into a tab-separated string for display
compute_inner_prod_tables: compute inner product tables for a ProductQuantizer given query vectors and a pre-trained quantizer
compute_distance_tables: compute L2 distance tables for a ProductQuantizer given query vectors and a pre-trained quantizer
